rows.note: Use this when an object, space, or facility is not currently being used.

example.english: This meeting room is unoccupied right now.
example.traditional: 呢間會議室而家冇人用。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 wui6 ji5 sat1 ji4 gaa1 mou5 jan4 jung6

rows.note: Use this mainly for a property or space left vacant, especially in formal or property-related contexts.

example.english: This office floor has been unoccupied for six months.
example.traditional: 呢層寫字樓空置咗半年。
example.jyutping: ne1 cang4 se2 zi6 lau4 hung1 zi3 zo2 bun3 nin4

rows.note: Use this when a home or other premises has no one living in it.

example.english: No one has lived in this house for years; it is unoccupied.
example.traditional: 呢間屋已經冇人住好多年喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 uk1 ji5 ging1 mou5 jan4 zyu6 hou2 do1 nin4 laa3
